  paste0("![](../stan/nonvegan/", 
         location_ids, 
         "_entire_nonvegan_outcome_predplot.png)"))

stan_vegan <- c(
  paste0("![](../stan/vegan/", 
         location_ids, 
         "_entire_vegan_outcome_predplot.png)"))

grid_search <- c(
 paste0("![](../grid_search/",
        location_ids,
        "_entire_nonvegan_outcome_predplot.png)"))

df <- data.frame("GridSearch" = grid_search,
                 "Stan Nonvegan" = stan,
                 "Stan Vegan" = stan_vegan,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

kable(df, format = "markdown", align = c("c", "c"))
